Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one
Subject: General
Strand: Strand 1
Topic 1.4: Writing 1.4.1 Pre- writing

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Writing 1.4.1 Pre- writing, part of Strand 1 in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade one General.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important to sit properly when writing? 2. How do we place our books when writing?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.
